limits: Generated saves only; personal saves and previous preview origins remain untouched.

Natural balance, conditioned hands and rough-work marks are original review examples; no race/bloodline roster or compulsory aging/maintenance is selected.
NPC recognition requires explicit demonstrated evidence in this slice; automatic population-wide perception remains authored work.
No inherited lineage history is invented; legacy acquisition origins remain unknown. New definitions require the updated fork.
Human content/pacing/Bio scrolling acceptance and broader physique/lineage/medical progression remain pending.
